title: Thymoquinone chemically conjugated to doxorubicin: antitumor activity and subcellular localization

A hybrid drug of thymoquinone (TQ)-doxorubicin (Dox) has been generated and characterized for cellular localization and anti-cancer activity in cancer cell lines.
